description: Frozen answers of acceptPostcode, countriesAcceptingPostcode, hasPostcodeForm and canComplete from @mailwoman/postcode on the postal family, and every input on which the removed implementation (the per-country RegExp set and PrefixAutomaton) answered otherwise, taken before it was deleted. Do not edit by hand. The IE answers follow the Eircode authority pattern of issue 3136: IE was removed from 1,408 accepting entries, the IE completion record and three canCompleteAll answers, and the two of those that then matched the removed implementation were dropped. The draw counts describe the original freeze.

sets.set: a: libaddressinput examples, prefixed forms and probes
b: every string up to 5 characters over 019A space hyphen
d1: real rows, postcode spans, raw rows, gauntlet inputs and postcodes (distinct)
d2: real rows, every distinct code unit
